sentences.text:
THIS APPEAL, COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY, THE COURT DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:
 JUDGMENT

The appeal is filed by the claimants under Section 173(1) of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988,
challenging the judgment and award dated 13.08.2008 in M.V.C. No.57/2007 passed by the learned Civil Judge (Sr.Dn.) & M.A.C.T., at Gangavathi, for seeking enhancement of compensation.
2. There is a delay of 3180 days in filing the appeal, which means delay of nine years in preferring the appeal.
The claimants have not stated cogent reasons for condoning such enormous delay.
Moreover, the Insurance Company has filed appeal before this Court challenging the very same judgment and award and it was dismissed.
Therefore, the claimants would have an opportunity to file cross-objection in the said appeal filed by the Insurance Company or would have filed independent appeal within reasonable period.
But the claimants have not availed opportunities.

After dismissal of the appeal by this Court NC: 2023:KHC-D:10710 filed by the Insurance Company,
after one year the present appeal is filed.
Therefore for all the reasons, there are no good grounds available so as to condone the delay of nine years.
Therefore, I.A.No.1/2017 is liable to be dismissed.
3. Even on the point of quantum also the Tribunal has considered notional income of Rs.6,000/- per month and awarded compensation which is found to be just and proper.
Therefore, the appeal is liable to be dismissed.

Accordingly, I proceed to pass the following:
ORDER I.A.No.1/2017 is dismissed.
Consequently the appeal is also dismissed.

SD/-
